topology.note: One logical authority for one match; each simulated client owns a distinct Node process/event loop.

accountingRecipientMapping.method: Unique maximum-weight one-to-one assignment over accepted frameId:exactWireBytes tuples in the full capture; scored metrics remain measurement-window-only so zero-cadence clients receive no credit.
accountingRecipientMapping.identityProofScope: full capture including setup and warmup

traffic.accountingBoundary: Exact application payload bytes accepted by authority ws.send callbacks; excludes WebSocket/TCP/TLS/WAN overhead.

authority.cpuBoundary: Exact cumulative authority process CPU delta divided by the same two health-sample timestamps; includes health polling and test-only replication accounting overhead.

ackRejectDiagnostics.orderScope: global arrival order within one match authority lifetime; not per-recipient causal order

publicProjectionWorkers.privacyBoundary: Only normalized public current/base views and opaque recipient work tokens cross workers.

ackRejectDiagnostics.orderScope: global arrival order within the current run; not per-recipient causal order

processBoundary.authority: sim tick, overload controller, public/owner projection, codec-candidate work per admitted recipient, pair selection, queueing, publish callbacks, ACK ingestion
processBoundary.isolatedClient: wire parse/decode, receiver validation/materialization, semantic hash/ACK construction, input/action serialization, ACK serialization/send
processBoundary.coordinator: session setup, health polling, wall-clock windowing, immutable evidence assembly only; no state-pair decode/apply/ACK

limitations: Codec Brotli q1 per-frame envelope with positional JSON fallback
No fleet packing, WAN, hosted WSS, AOI, or 24/48/96-client claim
